process: Worked example: chemical plant boiler replacement, 600-psig HP boiler + backpressure turbine-generator vs 100-psig LP boiler (Steam Tip Sheet #22)
measure: Install 600-psig boiler with backpressure turbine-generator instead of a new 100-psig boiler
note: Saving = 6,750,000 kWh x ($0.06 - $0.029)/kWh; capital cost of turbine set and incremental HP boiler cost not given. PRICE YEAR NOT STATED; publication year 2012 used
